questions.q: Where does Ruža say she "popped over"?
questions.e: In the video: "Pa rekla sam ti, skoknula sam do Ugrinovaca." — I told you, I popped over to Ugrinovci.

questions.q: How did Ruža get home?
o: Hung on to a garbage truck
questions.e: In the video: "ja se lepo popnem, ukačim se na kamion i tako stignem ovde" — I nicely climb up, hang on to the truck and so I get here.

questions.q: What did Ruža do in Ugrinovci?
o: Was an extra in a TV show
questions.e: In the video: "Ti si statirala u TV emisiji?" — You were an extra on a TV show?

questions.q: How was Ruža invited to the show?
questions.e: In the video: "Ali to je bilo preko Fejsbuka." — But it was through Facebook.

questions.q: What punishment does Beba threaten Mum with?
o: Lock her in for a week
Take her to a nursing home
questions.e: In the video: "nećemo igrati Ne ljuti se čoveče mesec dana" — we won't play Ludo for a month.

questions.q: What does Miša offer his brother?
o: To make him fifteen years younger
questions.e: In the video: "Ja ću da te podmladim za petnaest godina." — I'll make you fifteen years younger.

questions.q: Why was Ruža held at the police?
questions.e: In the video: "Majka ti je uhvaćena u krađi u jednoj prodavnici." — Your mother was caught stealing in a shop.

questions.q: Why does Ruža want to sue the shop owner?
o: A box was missing yellow pieces
He threw her out of the shop
questions.e: In the video: "Zato što je u jednoj kutiji falilo četiri figure žute." — Because one box was missing four yellow pieces.

questions.e: Kačiti se na + accusative plural: na tramvaje.

questions.q: Idi u ___ radnju.
questions.e: Where to? U + feminine accusative: u gvožđarsku radnju.
